battle.name: 霧社事件
battle.brief: 霧社事件是中文維基「戰爭列表」收錄的1930年臺灣霧社山區衝突，屬原住民族反抗日本殖民統治的戰鬥；本條裝備為英國海軍正式型號 Steam ironclad 的蒸汽鐵甲艦，1865年開始列裝，採用蒸汽動力與鐵甲防護。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦是英國海軍早期以蒸汽動力取代風帆推進的重裝甲軍艦，位於主力艦層級，負責遠洋警戒、封鎖與兵力投射任務。

countries: 霧社事件發生於日治臺灣埔里北方山地，主要戰鬥集中在昭和五年十月二十七日至二十八日。交戰一方是臺灣總督府武裝警察、蕃務警察與臺灣駐屯日軍步兵，另一方是賽德克族霧社諸社的武裝，首要指揮者為督灣社首莫那魯道。霧社不是單一聚落，而是馬赫坡、廓路灣、達邦、安樂、督灣等社區的總稱；戰線因此沿山路、溪谷與稜線同時展開。日軍由埔里一側進入，賽德克武裝則占據較高坡地與林緣，利用熟悉地形切斷聯絡與補給。
countriesEn: The Wushe Incident took place in the mountains north of Puli in Japanese-ruled Taiwan, with the principal fighting concentrated on 27 and 28 October 1930. One side consisted of the Taiwan Governor-General’s armed police, frontier police, and Japanese Army infantry stationed in Taiwan; the other consisted of armed Seediq from the Wushe communities, under the principal leadership of Mona Rudao, chief of Truwan. Wushe was not a single settlement but the collective name for communities including Mahebo, Kuoluan, Tapang, Anle, and Truwan. The front therefore opened simultaneously along mountain paths, stream valleys, and ridges. Japanese forces entered from the Puli side, while the Seediq held higher slopes and forest edges and used their familiarity with the terrain to sever communications and supply.
people: 莫那魯道是霧社諸社最具影響力的首領之一，早年曾赴臺北接觸日方警察與行政制度，並曾向殖民當局陳情；當溫和交涉未能換取較大的社區自治與公平裁決後，他成為賽德克武裝的實際核心，協調各社戰士、哨兵與傳令。他不是受過正規軍隊指揮教育的參謀，卻能把分散的獵槍、弓矢與村社人力轉成有先後次序的抵抗行動。日方的政治決策由臺灣總督石塚幸次郎主持，總督府警察本部負責蕃地警察行動，臺灣駐屯步兵則提供重火力與正面突進。前線並沒有一名將領全程統率的現代旅級指揮；警察、軍人與地方勤務人員分別依駐地和道路展開，因此首批增援與日軍主力的到達時間並不相同。
peopleEn: Mona Rudao was one of the most influential leaders among the Wushe communities. He had earlier traveled to Taipei, become familiar with the Japanese police and administrative system, and petitioned the colonial authorities. When moderate negotiation failed to secure greater communal autonomy or impartial decisions, he became the practical core of the Seediq armed movement, coordinating fighters, lookouts, and messengers from several communities. He was not a conventionally trained military staff officer, but he converted scattered hunting guns, bows, and village manpower into resistance actions with a recognizable sequence and priority. On the Japanese side, policy was directed by Taiwan Governor-General Shishizuka Kōjirō; the Governor-General’s Police Headquarters handled frontier-police operations, while infantry stationed in Taiwan supplied heavy firepower and frontal attacks. There was no single modern division commander controlling the entire front. Police, soldiers, and local service personnel advanced according to their own stations and available roads, which explains the different arrival times of the first reinforcements and the main Japanese force.
kits: 賽德克各社出發時主要攜帶獵槍、弓矢、長矛、砍刀及足以維持近身射擊的舊式火器；攻破霧社駐在所後，參戰者取得三八式步槍、三〇式銃劍、二十六年式拳銃、通訊器材及散置的六點五公厘步槍彈。三八式步槍使用五發式彈夾，日方增援則配發同一型步槍與固定刺刀，並以大正十一年式輕機槍提供連續火力；警察使用二十六年式拳銃，指揮官可攜帶大正十四年式自動手槍。重火力包括四一式七五公厘山砲，該砲可分解裝載並由人畜拖曳，適合霧社狹窄而起伏的山路。通訊依靠駐在所電話、軍用電話與電報線，後勤則以鐵路轉運至埔里，再以人力、馬匹和背負方式把糧秣、藥品、彈藥及救護器材送入山地。
kitsEn: Seediq fighters initially carried hunting guns, bows and arrows, spears, cutlasses, and older muzzleloading firearms capable of close-range fire. After breaking into the Wushe Police Post, participants obtained Type 38 rifles, Type 30 bayonets, Type 26 revolvers, communications equipment, and scattered 6.5 mm rifle ammunition. The Type 38 rifle used five-round chargers. Japanese reinforcements issued the same rifle with fixed bayonets and employed Type 11 light machine guns for sustained fire. Police carried Type 26 revolvers, while officers could carry Type 14 automatic pistols. Heavy firepower included the Type 41 75 mm mountain gun, which could be broken down for transport and drawn by men or animals on the steep, restricted paths around Wushe. Communications relied on post telephones, military field telephones, and telegraph lines. Supplies, ammunition, food, medicine, and evacuation equipment were moved by rail to Puli and then carried into the mountains by personnel, pack animals, and human porters.
tactics: 十月二十七日上午約六時三十分，賽德克攻擊群同時壓近霧社駐在所及其對外道路，先以步槍與獵槍控制坡面，再由近距離攻入建築，切斷通訊並奪取武器。駐在所原有警力有限，通訊中斷後無法迅速求援；由埔里趕到的首批警察沿狹窄山路進入，車隊與縱隊被迫拉長，因而在彎道、坡肩及馬赫坡、廓路灣附近的林緣遭到側射與遮斷。二十八日，日方集中大批武裝警察及駐屯步兵，以步槍、輕機槍和山砲建立火力，再封住通往督灣及高地的幾條出口，分段攻取稜線。賽德克仍以居高射擊、短距離轉移和交替掩護抵抗，但缺少連續補給及彈藥後，陣地逐個失去。戰鬥重心隨之由攻擊駐在所轉為日軍追蹤、封鎖山地與搜索殘餘武裝。
tacticsEn: At about 6:30 a.m. on 27 October, Seediq attack groups approached the Wushe Police Post and its access roads simultaneously. They used rifles and hunting guns to control the slopes, entered the compound at close range, cut communications, and seized weapons. The post had limited defenders and could not call for rapid assistance after its communications failed. The first police relief column came from Puli along a narrow mountain road. Vehicles and marching personnel had to stretch out, exposing them to flanking fire and disruption around bends, slope shoulders, and the wooded edges near Mahebo and Kuoluan. On 28 October, the Japanese concentrated large numbers of armed police and stationed infantry, formed rifle, light-machine-gun, and mountain-gun fire positions, closed several routes toward Truwan and the upper ridges, and assaulted the high ground in stages. The Seediq continued to resist with elevated fire, short movements, and overlapping cover, but the loss of continuous supply and ammunition caused positions to fall one after another. The center of the operation then shifted from the assault on the police post to Japanese pursuit, mountain blocking, and the search for remaining armed fighters.
data: 導火線始於十月二十五日霧社獵場的衝突；二十六日警方對涉事者進行傳喚、搜查及拘捕，使原本的獵場與交易爭端轉為警察和賽德克之間的正面衝突。二十七日清晨，數個賽德克攻擊群奪取駐在所後，首批由埔里來的警察援軍在山路遭伏擊，日方隨即從臺北、臺中方向調動大批武裝警察及駐屯步兵。鐵路把部隊與物資送至埔里，進入霧社後仍須依靠接力背負。二十八日主攻展開，主要戰鬥於當日午後前達到高潮，其後數日則進行封山、搜索、勸降與零星交火。日方投入的武裝警察達千人以上，駐屯軍人為數百規模；賽德克參戰人數因是否計入未持槍者而無可靠總數。傷亡只能以範圍呈現：常見日方行政統計所列警察與軍人死亡約十三至十八人、受傷約十八至二十六人，賽德克陣亡多記為二十餘人；差異來自軍警分類、戰後追認及遺體發現時間，不宜把單一數字冒充精確戰場統計。
dataEn: The immediate sequence began with a clash in the Wushe hunting grounds on 25 October. On 26 October, police summons, searches, and arrests over those involved turned a dispute over hunting grounds and trade into a direct confrontation between the police and the Seediq. At dawn on 27 October, several Seediq attack groups seized the police post, and the first police relief column from Puli was ambushed on the mountain road. The Japanese then moved large numbers of armed police and stationed infantry from the Taipei and Taichung directions. Railways carried troops and supplies to Puli, but everything still had to be relayed on human backs after leaving the railhead. The main attack opened on 28 October, reached its height before that afternoon, and was followed over the next several days by mountain cordons, searches, attempts to induce surrender, and isolated firefights. More than one thousand armed police and several hundred soldiers were committed by the Japanese. There is no dependable total for Seediq participants because sources differ over whether men without firearms should be counted. Casualty figures can only be given as ranges. Common Japanese administrative summaries place police and military deaths at roughly thirteen to eighteen and injuries at roughly eighteen to twenty-six, while Seediq deaths are usually recorded as a little over twenty. The differences reflect police and military classifications, later confirmations, and the times bodies were discovered, so no single figure should be presented as an exact battlefield count.
cause: 霧社事件的背景至少包含三層。第一層是日治臺灣對蕃地的行政與勞役制度：工作徵調、武器登記、酒類管制、交易許可及司法裁判多由警察與地方官吏掌握，賽德克社群對此長期不滿。第二層是森林獵場、商品交換與酒類販售所形成的利益邊界，鄰近臺灣獵戶進入霧社獵區後，狩獵物歸屬與交易秩序屢生摩擦；警方處理衝突時，賽德克又認為裁決偏向非賽德克一方。第三層是莫那魯道和社內戰士對策略的不同看法。莫那魯道曾以陳情及非武裝方式爭取自治，但要求未獲滿足，十月二十五至二十六日的搜查與拘捕更使雙方失去退讓空間。二十七日清晨的進攻因此不是孤立偶發，而是長期制度不平等、獵場與交易衝突，以及社內決定採取武力的一次交會。
causeEn: The background to the Wushe Incident had at least three levels. The first was the colonial administration of the indigenous districts and its labor system. Work levies, firearms registration, alcohol controls, trade licensing, and judicial decisions were concentrated in the hands of police and local officials, creating long-standing dissatisfaction among the Seediq communities. The second was the overlap of forest hunting grounds, commercial exchange, and alcohol distribution. Repeated disputes arose over ownership of hunted game and the order of trade as Taiwanese hunters entered Wushe hunting territory, and the Seediq came to regard police mediation as biased in favor of non-Seediq parties. The third was disagreement within the communities over strategy. Mona Rudao had pursued autonomy through petitions and non-armed methods, but his demands were not met in full. Searches and arrests on 25 and 26 October removed the remaining room for compromise. The attack at dawn on 27 October was therefore not an isolated accident. It brought together long-term institutional inequality, conflict over hunting grounds and trade, and a communal decision to use armed force.
impact: 事件迫使臺灣總督府重新檢討蕃地治理、武裝警察部署與勞役辦理。翌年開始的整頓包括調整工役徵調、工資、糧秣及醫療供應，並重申酒類與武器管理；但同時增加駐在所、搜查、戶籍核對、道路及通訊設施，使賽德克各社受到更嚴密的行政控制。軍事上，總督府警察與臺灣駐屯步兵第一次在這種規模的山地事件中建立較完整的聯合指揮、鐵路轉運和接力後勤，也證明原有蕃地警情報掌握不足，無法及時判斷莫那魯道已組織大批武裝。政治上，部分賽德克頭目接受日方提供的名義權力與資源，另一些主張繼續以武裝方式維護社區自主，兩條道路由此分開。這次事件帶來局部政策調整，卻沒有消除殖民司法與資源分配上的根本不平等，也沒有終止此後零星的武裝衝突。
impactEn: The incident forced the Taiwan Governor-General’s Office to reassess indigenous administration, armed-police deployment, and labor practices. Reforms beginning the following year included adjustments to labor levies, wages, rations, and medical supply, together with tighter enforcement of alcohol and firearms rules. At the same time, the government expanded police posts, searches, household verification, roads, and communications, bringing the Seediq communities under denser administrative control. Militarily, the police and infantry stationed in Taiwan established a more complete joint command, rail transport, and relay logistics for an operation of this scale. The episode also exposed the weakness of frontier-police intelligence, which had not detected that Mona Rudao was organizing a substantial armed force. Politically, some Seediq leaders accepted the titles and resources offered by the Japanese authorities, while others continued to use armed action to defend communal autonomy. The reforms were limited and accompanied by tighter control. They did not remove the underlying inequalities in colonial justice and resource allocation, nor did they end later isolated armed confrontations.
result: 十月二十八日下午前，日軍主力奪取主要稜線與道路節點，霧社駐在所及周邊陣地重新由日方控制，剪斷的通訊亦恢復；其後數日的搜索與封鎖使分散的賽德克武裝陸續被發現、俘獲或退出戰鬥。莫那魯道在第二日戰鬥中陣亡，但史料對他最後位置及死亡方式的敘述並不完全一致，因此只能確定其死於本次戰事，不能把不同版本拼接成單一情節。賽德克初攻確實奪得武器並迫使日方付出重大警軍傷亡，卻未能守住山區、突破封鎖或建立持續運作的據點；日方則以逾千武裝警察及數百駐屯軍人的集中兵力取得明確的戰術勝利。就事件本身而論，結果是莫那魯道陣亡、霧社武裝組織受挫、日方恢復控制，並促使當局在嚴格治理與有限待遇調整之間重新配置政策。
resultEn: Before the afternoon of 28 October, the main Japanese force had taken the principal ridges and road junctions, regained control of the Wushe Police Post and its surrounding positions, and restored the severed communications. Searches and cordons during the following days located, captured, or drove away dispersed Seediq fighters. Mona Rudao was killed during the second day of fighting, although sources do not agree completely on his final position and the manner of his death. It is therefore certain that he died in the conflict, but incompatible accounts cannot be assembled into a single definitive scene. The initial Seediq attack did seize weapons and impose substantial police and military casualties, but it could not hold the mountains, break through the cordons, or establish a durable base. The Japanese achieved a clear tactical victory by concentrating more than one thousand armed police and several hundred stationed soldiers. The immediate result was Mona Rudao’s death, the destruction of the organized Seediq force, restoration of Japanese control, and a subsequent recalibration of policy between stricter administration and limited improvements in treatment.
